    (p : Policy input C mode accounting Seed) (H0 : ℕ) : Prop :=

/-- Original complete-execution normal-I/O assumption for a selected
controller. Every halt is included, not only successful final outputs. -/
def CompletedNormalCallBound {Seed : Type*} (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I)
    (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I) (policy : PolicyRule I Seed)
    (H0 : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ sample n, (run input C mode accounting policy sample n).halted = true →
    (run input C mode accounting policy sample n).ledger.normalCalls ≤ (H0 : ℕ∞)

theorem normalCallCertificate_iff_completed_of_halts {Seed : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (input : StatisticalInput I) (C : Contract I) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting I)
    (policy : Policy input C mode accounting Seed) (H0 : ℕ)
    (hhalts : ∀ sample : Seed × input.World, ∃ n, (run input C mode accounting policy.rule sample n).halted = true) :
    NormalCallCertificate input C mode accounting policy H0 ↔
      CompletedNormalCallBound input C mode accounting policy.rule H0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hp sample n _hh
    exact hp sample n
  · intro hc sample n
    obtain ⟨finish, hh⟩ := hhalts sample
    have hm := run_normalCalls_mono input C mode accounting policy.rule sample
      (show n ≤ finish + n from Nat.le_add_left _ _)
    dsimp only at hm
    rw [run_after_halt input C mode accounting policy.rule sample finish hh n] at hm
    exact hm.trans (hc sample finish hh)

def IsPosteriorThresholdRule (E : BinaryExperiment) (p : ℚ)

  exact (∀ tape, test.rule.stop () tape = E.posteriorThresholdStop p tape) ∧

/-- `price-proofs.tex:23-31`, proved in PosteriorSPRT: the actual posterior-threshold SPRT has finite
conditional expectations and the sharp drift coefficient, with a constant fixed by E. -/
def PosteriorSPRTGuarantee (E : BinaryExperiment) : Prop :=
  ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ p : ℚ, 0 < p → p ≤ 1 / 4 →
    ∃ test : E.AdmissibleRule Unit,
      E.IsPosteriorThresholdRule p test ∧
      E.bayesError (Measure.dirac ()) test ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (p : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ x,
        E.expectedSamples (Measure.dirac ()) test x ≠ ⊤ ∧
        E.expectedObservationCharge (Measure.dirac ()) test x ≠ ⊤ ∧
        (E.expectedObservationCharge (Measure.dirac ()) test x).toReal ≤
          (E.observationFee : ℝ) / E.divergence x * (Real.log (1 / (p : ℝ)) + K)

theorem posteriorSPRTGuarantee (E : BinaryExperiment) : E.PosteriorSPRTGuarantee := by

    (fun N => by
      filter_upwards [E.expectedSamples_finite_stop ν test x hfinite] with sample hs
      exact E.truncatedCount_norm_le test N sample hs)
    (by

        (Filter.Eventually.mono (E.truncatedCount_eventually_eq test sample hs) (fun _ hN => hN.symm))

    (fun sample : Seed × E.Tape => E.logIncrementBound x * ((test.rule.stop sample.1 sample.2).toNat : ℝ))
    (fun N => (E.measurable_truncatedStoppedSum test x N).aestronglyMeasurable)

noncomputable def negativeLogMass (p : ℝ≥0∞) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  if p = 0 then ⊤ else ENNReal.ofReal (-Real.log p.toReal)

theorem binary_kl_lower (μ ν : Measure Bool) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (b : Bool) :
    μ {b} * negativeLogMass (ν {b}) ≤
      InformationTheory.klDiv μ ν + ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log 2) := by
  by_cases hac : μ ≪ ν
  · by_cases hb : ν {b} = 0
    · have hμ : μ {b} = 0 := hac hb
      simp [hμ]
    · by_cases hnb : ν {!b} = 0
      · have hv : ν {b} = 1 := by simpa only [hnb, add_zero] using bool_mass_add_compl ν b
        simp [hv]
      · have hp : 0 ≤ μ.real {b} := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
        have hp1 : μ.real {b} ≤ 1 := by
          have hmass : μ {b} ≤ (1 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
            calc
              μ {b} ≤ μ Set.univ := measure_mono (Set.subset_univ {b})
              _ = 1 := measure_univ
          simpa only [measureReal_def, ENNReal.toReal_one] using
            (ENNReal.toReal_mono (by simp : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤)
              hmass)
        have hq : 0 < ν.real {b} := ENNReal.toReal_pos hb (measure_ne_top ν {b})
        have hqn : 0 < ν.real {!b} := ENNReal.toReal_pos hnb (measure_ne_top ν {!b})
        have hq1 : ν.real {b} < 1 := by rw [bool_real_mass_compl ν b] at hqn; linarith
        have hbound := binary_real_kl_lower hp hp1 hq hq1
        rw [← bool_real_mass_compl μ b, ← bool_real_mass_compl ν b] at hbound
        rw [InformationTheory.klDiv_of_ac_of_integrable hac Integrable.of_finite]
        simp only [measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, add_sub_cancel_right]
        rw [bool_integral_llr μ ν hac b hb hnb]
        rw [negativeLogMass, ite_eq_right hb, ← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top μ {b}),
          ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul ENNReal.toReal_nonneg]
        exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hbound).trans ENNReal.ofReal_add_le
  · simp [InformationTheory.klDiv_of_not_ac hac]

theorem bool_kl_eq_top_of_positive_zero (μ ν : Measure Bool)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (b : Bool)
    (hμ : 0 < μ {b}) (hν : ν {b} = 0) : InformationTheory.klDiv μ ν = ⊤ := by
  apply InformationTheory.klDiv_of_not_ac
  intro hac

theorem localValueReal_sublinear (E : BinaryExperiment) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => E.localValueReal t / t) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  obtain ⟨K, _, hK⟩ := E.globalLogarithmicEnvelope
  have hupper : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => K * Real.log (1 + t) / t) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_div_assoc, mul_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul log_one_add_div_tendsto_zero :
        Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => K * (Real.log (1 + t) / t)) atTop (𝓝 (K * 0)))
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le'
    (g := fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) (h := fun t => K * Real.log (1 + t) / t)
    tendsto_const_nhds hupper
  · filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with t ht
    exact div_nonneg (E.localValueReal_nonneg t) ht.le
  · filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with t ht
    exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right ht).mpr (hK t ht.le)

/-- This estimate allows the good and bad leading terms to cancel exactly.
There is no assumption that their difference tends to infinity or is a
positive fraction of the bad continuation. -/
theorem localValue_difference_negligible (E : BinaryExperiment)
    (good bad scale : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hscale : Tendsto scale atTop atTop)
    (hbad : Tendsto (fun t => bad t / scale t) atTop (𝓝 B))
    (horder : ∀ᶠ t in atTop, 0 ≤ good t ∧ good t ≤ bad t) :
    Tendsto (fun t => E.localValueReal (bad t - good t) / scale t) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hscaleNe : ∀ᶠ t in atTop, scale t ≠ 0 := hscale.eventually_ne_atTop 0
  have hbadTop : Tendsto bad atTop atTop := by
    have hprod := Filter.Tendsto.pos_mul_atTop hB hbad hscale
    apply hprod.congr'
    filter_upwards [hscaleNe] with t ht
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ (bad t) ht
  have hbadPos : ∀ᶠ t in atTop, 0 < bad t := hbadTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hbound⟩ := E.globalLogarithmicEnvelope
  have hupper : Tendsto (fun t => K * Real.log (1 + bad t) / bad t) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hlog := log_one_add_div_tendsto_zero.comp hbadTop
    simpa only [mul_div_assoc, mul_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul hlog :
        Tendsto (fun t => K * (Real.log (1 + bad t) / bad t)) atTop (𝓝 (K * 0)))
  have hratio : Tendsto (fun t => E.localValueReal (bad t - good t) / bad t) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le'
      (g := fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) (h := fun t => K * Real.log (1 + bad t) / bad t)
      tendsto_const_nhds hupper
    · filter_upwards [hbadPos] with t ht
      exact div_nonneg (E.localValueReal_nonneg _) ht.le
    · filter_upwards [hbadPos, horder] with t ht ho
      apply (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right ht).mpr
      apply (hbound _ (sub_nonneg.mpr ho.2)).trans
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hK
      exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith : 0 < 1 + (bad t - good t)) (by linarith)
  have hprod : Tendsto (fun t =>
      (E.localValueReal (bad t - good t) / bad t) * (bad t / scale t)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_mul] using hratio.mul hbad
  apply hprod.congr'
  filter_upwards [hscaleNe, hbadPos] with t hs hb
  field_simp [hs, ne_of_gt hb]

noncomputable def eventualFlag (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee)

    (rule : PolicyRule P.sharedInstance Seed) (predicate : State P.sharedInstance → Prop)

theorem measurable_eventualFlag (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee)
    (C : P.PaymentContract) (mode : ResourceMode) (accounting : NormalAccounting P.sharedInstance)
    (rule : PolicyRule P.sharedInstance Seed) (hm : MeasurableRule rule) (predicate : State P.sharedInstance → Prop) :
    Measurable (P.eventualFlag fee hfee C mode accounting rule predicate) := by
  classical
  apply measurable_to_bool
  have hmeas : MeasurableSet {sample : Seed × (P.input fee hfee).World |
      ∃ n, predicate (run (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting rule sample n)} := by
    have heq : {sample : Seed × (P.input fee hfee).World |
        ∃ n, predicate (run (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting rule sample n)} =
        ⋃ n : ℕ, {sample | predicate (run (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting rule sample n)} := by
      ext sample
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
    rw [heq]
    exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => (measurable_run (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting rule hm n)
      (MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_top (s := {state | predicate state}))
  simpa only [eventualFlag, Function.comp_def, Set.preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, decide_eq_true_eq] using hmeas

  classical
  exact (fun i => P.eventualFlag fee hfee C mode accounting rule (fun state => state.ledger.written i = some (state.ledger.truth i)) sample,
    fun i => P.eventualFlag fee hfee C mode accounting rule (fun state => state.ledger.written i = some (!state.ledger.truth i)) sample,
    (fun i tool => P.eventualFlag fee hfee C mode accounting rule (fun state =>
      ∃ e ∈ state.ledger.executions, e.handle.stage = i ∧ e.tool = tool) sample),
    decide (¬ runSuccess (P.input fee hfee) C.val mode accounting rule sample))

    apply measurable_to_bool
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Set.preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, decide_eq_true_eq, Set.compl_ofPred] using

theorem calibratedAlgorithm_uncapped_guarantee (P : Parameters)
    (implementation : P.CalibratedImplementationClaims)

  by_cases zeroBranch : P.zeroChargeRisk fee ≤ P.certificate.risk
  · have original := (termination fee hfee C accounting).1 zeroBranch
    constructor
    · rw [PDROC.CalibratedSelector.zeroBranch_risk_eq_ideal P fee hfee C .uncapped accounting zeroBranch]

        original.1]

    dsimp only at calibrated

      simpa only [Parameters.idealSearchRule, Parameters.idealSearchSeedLaw, ite_eq_right zeroBranch]

    simp only [Parameters.calibratedAlgorithmSeedLaw, ite_eq_right zeroBranch]

    · exact le_of_eq (calibrated.2.1.trans sourceRisk)

          calibrated.2.2.2.2.2.1

def FixedPoolUniformFeePrice (pool : FixedSharedPool) : Prop :=
  ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon → epsilon < 1 → ∃ cutoff : ℝ, 0 < cutoff ∧
    ∀ (delta : ℚ) (hd : 0 < delta) (hs : delta ≤ 1 / 64), (delta : ℝ) < cutoff →
      ∀ (fee : ℚ) (hfee : 0 ≤ fee) (C : Contract pool.sharedInstance)
        (hC : C.IsCurrentPayment) (accounting : NormalAccounting pool.sharedInstance),
        pool.JointControllerQualification delta hd hs fee hfee C hC accounting →
          pool.FixedPoolPriceNumericalConclusion delta fee hfee C accounting epsilon

/-- The stated K=0 asymptotic B_delta~S_delta is separate from the already
proved exact fee-independence of the entire input and Native.value. -/
def ZeroToolsStructuralSaturation (pool : FixedSharedPool) : Prop :=
  pool.tools = 0 →
    ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon → epsilon < 1 → ∃ cutoff : ℝ, 0 < cutoff ∧
      ∀ delta : ℚ, 0 < delta → delta ≤ 1 / 64 → (delta : ℝ) < cutoff →
        ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - epsilon) * pool.structuralScaleReal delta) ≤ pool.saturationScale delta ∧
          pool.saturationScale delta ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + epsilon) * pool.structuralScaleReal delta)

def FixedPoolNativePriceClaims (pool : FixedSharedPool) : Prop :=
  pool.FixedPoolUniformFeePrice ∧ pool.ZeroToolsFeeIndependence ∧ pool.ZeroToolsStructuralSaturation

theorem fixedPoolUniformFeePrice_of_nativeSeparation (pool : FixedSharedPool)
    (separation : ∀ P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters, P.NativeSeparationClaims) :
    pool.FixedPoolUniformFeePrice := by
  intro epsilon hepsilon hepsilonOne
  obtain ⟨cutoff, hcutoff, hsqueeze⟩ := freeNativeSqueeze pool epsilon hepsilon hepsilonOne
  refine ⟨cutoff, hcutoff, ?_⟩
  intro delta hdelta hsmall hdeltaCutoff fee hfee C hC accounting qualification
  have hfreeQualification := pool.jointQualification_free delta hdelta hsmall fee hfee
    C hC accounting qualification
  have hpaidQualification := pool.jointQualification_paid delta hdelta hsmall fee hfee
    C hC accounting qualification
  obtain ⟨hfreeLower, hfreeUpper⟩ := hsqueeze delta hdelta hsmall hdeltaCutoff
    C hC accounting hfreeQualification
  have hnonnegLower : 0 ≤ 1 - epsilon := by linarith
  have hnonnegUpper : 0 ≤ 1 + epsilon := by linarith
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul hnonnegLower] at hfreeLower
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul hnonnegUpper] at hfreeUpper
  have hperturb := PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters.minPerturbation epsilon hepsilon.le hepsilonOne
    (pool.nativeValue delta 0 (by norm_num) C accounting) (pool.structuralScale delta)
    (pool.feeScale fee) (pool.saturationScale delta) hfreeLower hfreeUpper
  have hnative := separation (pool.atRisk delta hdelta hsmall) fee hfee ⟨C, hC⟩ accounting
  obtain ⟨hpaidUpper, _hwitness⟩ := hnative.2 hpaidQualification
  have hlower :
      min (pool.nativeValue delta 0 (by norm_num) C accounting + pool.feeScale fee)
        (pool.saturationScale delta) / 129 ≤ pool.nativeValue delta fee hfee C accounting :=
    hnative.1
  have hupper : pool.nativeValue delta fee hfee C accounting ≤
      72 * min (pool.nativeValue delta 0 (by norm_num) C accounting + pool.feeScale fee)
        (pool.saturationScale delta) := hpaidUpper
  constructor
  · exact (ENNReal.div_le_div_right hperturb.1 129).trans hlower
  · calc
      _ ≤ 72 * min (pool.nativeValue delta 0 (by norm_num) C accounting + pool.feeScale fee)
          (pool.saturationScale delta) := hupper
      _ ≤ 72 * (ENNReal.ofReal (1 + epsilon) * pool.priceScale delta fee) :=
        mul_le_mul' le_rfl hperturb.2
      _ = _ := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

theorem fixedPoolNativePriceClaims_of_nativeSeparation (pool : FixedSharedPool)
    (separation : ∀ P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters, P.NativeSeparationClaims) :
    pool.FixedPoolNativePriceClaims :=
  ⟨fixedPoolUniformFeePrice_of_nativeSeparation pool separation,
    pool.zeroToolsFeeIndependence, zeroToolsStructuralSaturation pool⟩

theorem fixedPoolNativePriceClaims (pool : PaperProofs.Paid.FixedSharedPool) :
    pool.FixedPoolNativePriceClaims :=
  fixedPoolNativePriceClaims_of_nativeSeparation pool nativeSeparationClaims

end PDLower
